item.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate in Mathematical Physics – Closing date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 - 12:00
item.description: We are currently inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Research Associate to work with Professors Mezei, Schafer-Nameki, and Sparks at the Mathematical Institute, University of Oxford. These are three-year, fixed-term positions, funded by three different research grants from the ERC, UKRI, and STFC. The successful candidate will be expected to be in post by 1 October 2027.
